name: soujo
description: Resumable spec → plan → layer workflow shared by Claude Code and Codex

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/cli.js', 0o755)"
